Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Shipping Download
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        This allows XML download of Shipments and related data into the application. For more specifics and examples on Interfacing in the application, consult the help.


     Request



    
        URI: http://ServerName/general/interfaces/shipments-Downloaded

        Method: POST

        Content-Type: application/json or application/xml

        Entity: application/vnd.manh.ils.interfaces.interfaceRequest+json, xml

        Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential
    

        Note that the xmlData field in the request must conform to ShippingDownload.xsd schema. Also, if a XML content-type is used then the xmlData element must have a string value that is encoded to ensure a well-formed xml interfaceRequest.



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                
                    OK will be accompanied by an entity conforming to one of the requested media types: application/vnd.manh.ils.interfaces.interfaceResponse+json, xml

This allows XML download of Shipments and related data into the application. For more specifics and examples on Interfacing in the application, consult the help.




     Request





    

        
URI: http://ServerName/general/interfaces/shipments-Downloaded


        
Method: POST


        
Content-Type: application/json or application/xml


        
Entity: application/vnd.manh.ils.interfaces.interfaceRequest+json, xml


        
Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential

    


    
    Note that the xmlData field in the request must conform to ShippingDownload.xsd schema. Also, if a XML content-type is used then the xmlData element must have a string value that is encoded to ensure a well-formed xml interfaceRequest.
